title: Reqistry
description: Discover, compare, and monitor 1,400+ APIs directly from your AI coding agent.
summary: Discover, compare, and monitor 1,400+ APIs directly from your AI coding agent.
offersHint: Discover, compare, and monitor 1,400+ APIs directly from your AI coding agent. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.reqistry.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all active API categories with the number of published APIs in each. Use to populate a category filter or browse by topic.

toolsPreview.name: get_category_apis
toolsPreview.description: List published APIs in a category by slug (e.g. 'weather', 'finance'). Paginated. Use list_categories first to get a category slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_api
toolsPreview.description: Get full detail for one API by slug or id, including health, metadata, verification, and warnings. Use after browsing a category to drill in.

toolsPreview.name: get_alternatives
toolsPreview.description: Find alternative APIs similar to a given API id — prefers same category, falls back to same API type. limit must be 2 or 3 (default 3).

toolsPreview.name: check_health
toolsPreview.description: Trigger (or return cached) a health check for one API. Returns CACHED within cooldown, or QUEUED with a poll URL. Rate-limited per device.

toolsPreview.name: submit_api
toolsPreview.description: Submit a new API for review. Creates a 'pending' submission (not immediately published). At least name or link required. Email optional.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_apis
toolsPreview.description: Get recommended APIs — personalized when the device has bookmarks, otherwise random picks. Optional limit (max 50).
